message: 負け犬たち

name: Synn
message: 「How is Nanaka's progress on her assignments coming along?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「As you can see, since I'm right here with her, everything is going smoothly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's a curious thing, being thanked by you, Kaichou-han, rather than by the girl herself.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka is grateful too, you know.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You aren't her, yet you can tell?」

name: Synn
message: 「We've known each other a long time.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Is that so? Then wouldn't it be fine without you asking me?」

name: Synn
message: 「She tries to slack off right away, doesn't she?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Not necessarily. She knows very well that I won't let her go until she finishes her assignments.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Not quite as long as you, Kaichou-han, though she and I go back fairly far ourselves.」

name: Synn
message: 「Longer than with Ria-senpai?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Yes, indeed. Time isn't everything, though. Even after a long time, what you don't understand, you simply don't understand.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The longer you associate with someone, the more you come to understand--and the more mysteries appear as well.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now then, it seems our talk is finished, so would you mind if I excused myself?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, ah, yes--sorry to trouble you.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You're a surprisingly complicated person yourself, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that... so?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Does talk like that really matter at all? Right?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Excuse me.」
She saw right through me.
About what's been bothering Nanaka.

name: Misasagi
message: 「I haven't even told Rii-a my bust size, you know. Even if it's you, President, that's one thing I just can't divulge.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? No, that's not what I'm trying to ask.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm practically a regular at Yuugiri-an, wouldn't you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「If you go there three days a week, I'd definitely call you a regular.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Still, it seems she's placed a hundred-year curse on me and me alone, so I simply have to live a long life.」

name: Synn
message: 「A curse?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「As proof, she always serves me soba that she kneaded and cut herself.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「She must be pouring heaps of curses into every single stroke, I'm sure of it. She said so herself, after all. Oh, how frightening.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... Curse aside, that's a little surprising.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There's nothing surprising about it at all. That girl is the type who always takes the roundabout way.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka? No way.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「She calls it a curse, you see, but deep down that's not it at all. She just wants to make me groan in delight.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I wouldn't mind just giving a little groan, really.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's just that she keeps glancing over with those eyes saying, 'Come on, let's hear you groan,' so I eat it with a completely straight face.」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, indulge her with a groan every once in a while.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Groaning while eating is terribly bad manners. For someone as well-bred as myself, it's simply impossible.」

name: Synn
message: 「Haha.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「And so, what she's doing right now is that very same sort of thing.」

name: Synn
message: 「That very same sort of thing?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You don't understand? Even though you're doing the exact same thing yourself, President. How curious.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If you truly wanted to find out what she's up to, there are any number of ways to go about it, yet why don't you?」
Now that she mentions it, she's right.
At night. I could just drop by Yuugiri-an and ask to come inside for a bit.
I even know that the back door key is hidden underneath the potted azalea.
Even without going that far, Nanaka's voice isn't quiet, so if I listen closely, I can probably tell roughly what she's doing from her conversation.
Still.

name: Synn
message: 「...Forcing my way in to uncover something she's going out of her way to hide...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's just an excuse. Isn't the reason you're talking with me like this because you want to know?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Don't you even understand yourself, President?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Up until now, the two of you have had such an effortless, unguarded relationship. It felt as natural as breathing.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「However, it wasn't natural at all. It only lasted because you and Nanaka were actively trying to maintain that dynamic. It was nothing like breathing.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If keeping things going the exact same way requires one of you to put up with it, well, things are bound to get rather complicated.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Even when playing catch, if your partner suddenly changes the way they throw, you'll drop the ball, won't you? Changing something that's been going smoothly is a scary thing.」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean me?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm strictly speaking in general terms. It applies to anyone, myself included.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Though I wouldn't really know.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It'd be totally uncool to retort with, 'You don't even know?!'」

name: Synn
message: 「You shouldn't have said it then.」
Playing catch, huh...
Come to think of it, I used to play catch with Nanaka a lot back in the day...
Oops, if I don't hurry, lunch break is going to end.

name: Nanaka
message: 「You traitor, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
When I turned around, Nanaka was standing in the shadow of a pillar.

name: Nanaka
message: 「What were you talking about with Bubuzuke? Don't tell me you sold your soul for traditional sweets!」

name: Synn
message: 「It wasn't a big deal.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama here was worried about whether you're properly doing your assignments!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm relieved to hear you're keeping up with them.」
That's not a lie.

name: Nanaka
message: 「...There's no way you'd talk for that long just about that.」

name: Synn
message: 「She has a roundabout way of talking, so...」
Sorry for making you sound like the bad guy.
I can't help feeling like half of it is true, though.

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, yeah, maybe, but... it's your fault, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... sorry.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, you actually did something worth apologizing for!?」
It's true that I tried to pry out whatever Nanaka was keeping quiet about.

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, ah, um, well, I mean, for suspecting you hadn't made any progress on your assignment.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Is that really all?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, really.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You weren't trying to make a move on Bubuzuke this time or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How did you jump to that conclusion!? Besides, what do you mean 'this time'... I've never tried to make a move on anyone.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But... you kissed me, didn't you.」
Thankfully there's no one around, but would she really bring that up right here!?

name: Synn
message: 「W-We agreed to treat that as an accident. You agreed too, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, excuse me for causing an 'accident' then.」
Hearing her call it an accident makes me feel weirdly sad.
Even though the two of us decided to treat it that way.

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What's your deal, staring at my face like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, no, I mean.」

name: Synn
message: 「It wasn't your fault at all, Nanaka! It's just because I woke up all of a sudden... Even though it was your first time... um...」
That's right... it was her first time...

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Don't apologize.」

name: Synn
message: 「But still, I just.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-Anyway, it's your fault, y'hear! If you don't wanna be suspected, just don't talk to anyone besides me, y'hear!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaaat. That's completely unreasonable!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm... acting weird... At this rate, he's gonna hate me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka. You told me not to ask, but still--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Of course that's a lie! I'm not that annoying of a girl. I just really hate bubuzuke, that's all!」
